thread:
Jules: Heads-up — Acme wants our SOC 2 report + access to a few evidence files for their vendor review. They asked for a bridge letter and a presigned link to the evidence bucket. Need: SOC2 PDF, config screenshots, a couple of sanitized logs. They want this by EOD Friday. Can legal/security confirm what's okay to share and max presign expiry?

Maya: @Jules we can do a bridge/acknowledgement letter pending a fully executed NDA. Need to know the exact signer (company/legal contact) and whether they require raw logs or a redacted snapshot. Presigned links: legal prefers <=7 days, security usually asks for shorter. Also need list of specific files/paths.

Zach: Re: logs — we should NOT share raw logs with IPs or tenant IDs. Recommend producing a redacted snapshot: replace IPs/hashes, strip request bodies, keep timestamps and control evidence. For presign expiration, 72h is my preferred max. If Legal insists on 7d that's OK with additional access logging.

Jules: Signer is "Acme Security Ops (procurement@acme.com)". File list from them:
- soc2/Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf
- infra/vpc-config.png
- infra/gke-config.png
- logs/poc-sample-2025-03.tar.gz (they asked specifically for a sample)

Maya: Ok. For the tarball we'd only provide a sanitized sample. Can you confirm which artifacts in the tarball are needed? Also @Tara can you draft a short bridge ack that says we acknowledge proof of SOC 2 and that access is temporary and governed by signed NDA?

Tara: Drafted below, feel free to tweak: 
```
Redwood Inference - Interim SOC 2 Acknowledgement
Date: <date>
To: <Customer Legal / Contact>
We confirm Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II controls and can provide a limited evidence snapshot for vendor review. Access provided is temporary, limited to the items listed, and governed by a signed NDA. Access will expire on the date specified in the presigned link. For questions contact security@redwood.ai.
```
This is intentionally short — we don't want to recreate the full report.

Ben: I can generate the presigned link once we have file names and confirmation from Security + Legal. Plan: copy sanitized files to s3://redwood-sec-staging/acme-<ticket-id>/ then presign. Example aws cli command: 
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-sec-staging/acme-12345/Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf --expires-in 259200
```
(note 259200 = 72 hours). If Legal wants 7d use 604800. Also will enable server-side logging and tag the object for audit.

Zach: We'll prepare the sanitized tarball and the redaction checklist. Quick checklist: remove IPs, remove hostnames with tenant IDs, truncate full request/response bodies, redact user identifiers. I'll output a manifest.txt describing redactions so auditors know what was removed.

Maya: Sounds good. Two asks for Sales: 1) get Acme to sign the NDA today (or give us countersigned PDF), 2) confirm acceptance of a 72h presign (legal can bend to 7d if they insist). Once we have NDA and file list, Tara/Legal will sign the bridge ack and Ben will presign.

Jules: I'll ping Acme procurement now and push for NDA + acceptance of 72h. If they push for 7 days, I'll flag for you, @Maya. Timeline: we aim to deliver redacted SOC2 snapshot by EOD today and presigned link tomorrow morning.

Tara: I'll add a line in the bridge ack about expiring access and audit logging.

Ben: FYI — small ops note: if the tarball contains large binary artifacts (heap dumps etc.) we'll need to reject or further limit. Please flag anything >50MB.

Jules: Good call. Acme requested the tarball but didn't specify size — I'll ask them to narrow to the sample files in logs/<path>.

Zach: I'll start preparing the sanitized artifacts now. Will post manifest + checksum here when done.

Maya: Thank you all. Keep the convo here so Legal has the thread for the NDA/bridge request. :thumbsup:

Jules: Thanks team — I'll update once NDA signed or if Acme insists on 7d.
